_purpose: Default-FAIL evidence contract for the Godzilla Smash gz-v14->v15->v16 autonomous campaign. Every unit starts passes:false. NEVER flip passes:true without ALL THREE of a verifiable evidence string + a real git tag + a real commit SHA, written in the commit AFTER the fix (atomic ship).
_operating_mode: ONE session model exclusively (claude-opus-4-8[1m]); every agent() inherits it, no pins, no downgrade. FULL ULTRACODE POOLS per non-trivial unit: re-ground -> design -> 3-lens adversarial verify ALWAYS -> 3-vote -> implement -> 5-gate -> tag + flip JSON + push; capstone loops til 2 dry (cap 4). Cleanup of dead/duplicated code is AUTHORIZED requested work. Effort = session-global Ultracode dial, not per-leg.
_confidence_calibration: <90% -> BLOCKERS + pivot; 90-96% -> proceed + note the alternative in the commit; >=97% -> proceed. Human-locked picks immutable -> if one looks wrong, BLOCKERS HIGH + pivot, never override.
_per_commit_gate: 2. preview cache-bust per godzilla-preview-verification-gotcha (unregister SW -> delete caches -> refetch {cache:'reload'} -> location.href='./?fresh='+Date.now()); console clean
3. behavior: unit eval-drive assertions vs LIVE objects pass (drive frames manually; tab is document.hidden) OR visual unit captures a screenshot to docs/campaign/shots/
4. regression: unit named no-change checks pass
5. drift (deploy units): sw.js CACHE === config.CACHE_VERSION; campaign-progress.json + CAMPAIGN-BOOT.md updated in the ship commit. Doc-only commits may skip 1-4 with a justification line.

_run_policy._locked: Continuous + async feel-queue; KMP deferred; balance + touch numbers research-locked to >=97% (author drafts are fallbacks); >=97% latitude to touch anything; rollback = git reset --hard <prev-tag>.
_run_policy.auto_fix_ceiling: trivial/low @>=0.95 freely; medium @>=0.97 + verify; defer high-risk / <0.90 / net-new to BLOCKERS.
_run_policy.lean_before_add: Reuse existing helpers (Utils.fmt, iso.worldToScreenInto, World.footprintsNear, _wyrmHelpers, FX pool, Env.announce) before adding new code; the audit named the reuse points.
halt_only_on: a human-locked pick that looks wrong
final pre-ship review after v16 deploy
_run_policy.halt_mechanism: set _halt to the gate name + write a BLOCKERS.md envelope + ONE consolidated PushNotification; pivot to the next un-gated unit.
_run_policy.delegated_no_halt: G1 feel verdicts are async and DO NOT stop the run — they queue as STEER notes and fold into a tuning pass at the next version boundary.
_run_policy.reground_gate: MANDATORY before any resumed unit: an inherit-session-model workflow refutes the unit's plan scope vs current HEAD (file:line anchors were checked at gz-v13 and drift as units land). If scope changed, re-find before fixing.

verify_intensity.high_stakes: U3 nova-slam (new input+sim+render+audio seam), U9 consolidations (behavior-identical claim), U12 facing-unify (twice-bug-fixed, regression-sensitive) -> full panel + capstone til 2 dry.
verify_intensity.research: UR -> multi-source web research + adversarial verify to >=97%; un-reachable items -> BLOCKERS + documented fallback.

_run_policy.finish_line: gz-v16 deployed live + all of U1..U13 passes:true; D1 presented to Mike (not implemented); final pre-ship review handed over.

self_heal.FM-1: overload -> same-model ladder (tighten schema / reduce parallel width / backoff-retry); NEVER downgrade; a truncated whole-context scan ABORTS+restarts. <2 landed votes -> inconclusive -> orchestrator code-read self-verify.
self_heal.FM-2: per-commit gate RED after apply -> git reset --hard <prev-tag>, move finding to BLOCKERS, continue. Never fix-forward from broken.
self_heal.FM-3: ambiguous/uncitable canon -> 'I don't see this in the log' -> BLOCKERS + pivot. Never invent a locked decision.

_run_policy.gate_queue_mode: SELF-WAKE: gates are async; the run never idles on a gate while un-gated work exists; ScheduleWakeup long-fallback (1800-3600s) + probe + resume on clear; SUSPEND self-wake while quota near-exhausted (it burns quota; Mike resumes).
true_stop_conditions: 1. All of U1..U13 shipped + a self-wake pending (park, await G1 feel verdicts / G2 design pick)
3. A human-locked pick that looks wrong (BLOCKERS HIGH + pivot)
4. Budget/quota near-exhausted -> park at a clean tag boundary + resume on refresh
5. The final pre-ship review after the gz-v16 deploy
